global: A bowl of shio ramen features a clear, light broth with tender chashu pork and crisp green onions atop the noodles. The white ceramic bowl, branded with black characters, sits on a blue surface under bright, even lighting.

regions.background: Blue textured table surface with subtle grain, slightly reflective, showing faint water droplets and a red object edge.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with black calligraphy, smooth glossy surface, slightly raised rim, and subtle inner curve.
regions.soup: Shio ramen broth with noodles, garnished with green onions and chashu pork, appears clear, golden, and steaming hot.
regions.meat: Chashu pork: tender, glistening slices with caramelized brown edges and visible marbling, slightly curled at the edges.
